title: The salt wells: No Salt for the Soup!
kaylee: The village dinner is tonight and nobody has any salt! Pa Kluea remembers carrying her grandma's salt to every pot, so Kaylee becomes her salt carrier. She makes the salt, then at dusk she sprinkles it from her hand onto Lung Kwai's soup, Pa Kai's eggs and Yai Nak's fish. Every lantern lights up, and then the party starts.
questions: The three cooks (Lung Kwai, Pa Kai, Yai Nak): funny, or too much?
The way in is about 45 seconds: keep it all, or cut the empty jar or the memory?
Keep the name Pa Kluea (Auntie Salt)?
